description: This file defines the CityFinder class in an Android project, containing methods to set latitude and longitude in a shared location reference and to retrieve the city name from geographical coordinates using Android's Geocoder.
external_methods: Geocoder.getFromLocation(double latitude, double longitude, int maxResults)

classes.name: CityFinder
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for handling location data and geocoding to obtain city names.

methods.name: setLongitudeLatitude
methods.description: Sets the latitude and longitude in the LocationCord class based on a Location object.

methods.name: getCityNameUsingNetwork
methods.description: Retrieves the city name corresponding to given location coordinates using Android's Geocoder.
